title: AI Engineer (All Level - Computer Vision/NLP/LLM) - Khối Công Nghệ Thông Tin (2026TD450582)
company: ProNGÂN HÀNG TMCP QUÂN ĐỘI – MBBANK
jd_text:
MB là một trong những ngân hàng hệ sinh thái Số dẫn đầu tại Việt Nam, với định hướng trở thành “Doanh nghiệp số, Tập đoàn tài chính dẫn đầu”, công nghệ tại MB hiện được thúc đẩy dựa trên 5 trụ cột cốt lõi: công nghệ mới, tự động hóa, dữ liệu, AI và con người. Tính đến năm 2026, ngân hàng đang được phục vụ gần 40 triệu khách hàng, xử lý hơn 12,4 tỷ giao dịch trên kênh Số. Hiện tại, chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm  cơ hội hợp tác cùng các ứng viên AI Engineer, Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer có năng lực chuyên môn sâu để gia nhập và phát triển các sản phẩm Số phục vụ quy mô người dùng lớn. Đây sẽ là cơ hội để Bạn thực hiện khát vọng phát triển những nền tảng ứng dụng AI tiên tiến cùng tiềm năng tạo ảnh hướng lớn đến cộng đồng cùng MB.Mô tả công việc:Nhân sự AI tại MB sẽ tham gia các dự án khác nhau tùy theo thế mạnh chuyên môn và nhu cầu phát triển năng lực của bản thân, có thể kể đến các mảng công việc sau:Thiết kế và triển khai các giải pháp AI/ML toàn diện (end-to-end), như LLM, pipeline RAG, semantic search), AI Agent, chatbot, fraud detection.Thiết kế và triển khai các giải pháp AI/ML trong lĩnh vực Thị giác máy tính (Computer Vision), bao gồm eKYC, OCR, segmentation, classification, camera AI.Coding, test metrics, service và unit test theo mô hình DevOps, MLOpsTích hợp và tối ưu hóa quy trình làm việc AI bằng các framework và công cụ như LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face,...Nghiên cứu và áp dụng các nghiên cứu mới ( SOTA) như Reinforcement Learning, Self-Supervised Learning và Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning...Với nhóm ứng viên là sinh viên tài năng và fresher: yêu cầu tham gia các chương trình đào tạo và dự án mới tại MB để để phát triển lên các vị trí Kỹ sư cấp cao tại MB trong tương lai gần.

Học vấn:Tốt nghiệp Đại học trở lên các chuyên ngành: Công nghệ thông tin, Khoa học máy tính, Kỹ thuật phần mềm, Hệ thống thông tin, Điện tử Viễn thông, Trí tuệ nhân tạo (AI), Khoa học dữ liệu hoặc các ngành liên quan.Kiến thức và kỹ năng chuyên môn:Ứng viên cần có nển tảng chuyên môn tốt về một hoặc nhiều mảng sau:1. Lập trình:Thành thạo một trong các ngôn ngữ: Python, C/C++.Có kinh nghiệm phát triển Backend Service/Microservices với các framework như FastAPI, Flask hoặc Django.2. Machine Learning & Deep LearningCó kinh nghiệm sử dụng ít nhất 01 framework AI/ML phổ biến như: PyTorch, TensorFlow,...Nắm vững các mô hình và thuật toán Machine Learning/Deep Learning như: Supervised Learning, Reinforcement Learning; CNN, Transformer...Có kinh nghiệm về tối ưu mô hình: Knowledge Distillation, Model Pruning, Model Quantization, Inference Optimization...3. AI ApplicationsCó kinh nghiệm nghiên cứu hoặc triển khai các bài toán về:Computer Vision (CV), Image Processing, Video Analytics, eKYC, Document AI.Natural Language Processing (NLP)Speech/Audio Processing.Fraud Detection4. MLOps & AI DeploymentCó kinh nghiệm sử dụng:  Git, Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, Kubeflow, TensorFlow Serving, Triton Inference Server""MB Bank yêu cầu ứng viên ứng tuyển cần cung cấp chi tiết các thông tin sau:Thông tin cá nhân: Họ và tên, Ngày tháng năm sinh, Giới tínhSố điện thoại và Email liên hệTrình độ học vấn, Trường đã tốt nghiệpKinh nghiệm làm việcTừ 3 - 5 kỹ năng nổi bậtVì sao Bạn nên đảm bảo đầy đủ thông tin khi ứng tuyển?Hồ sơ của Bạn sẽ được đánh giá nhanh chóng.Đối với các hồ sơ đáp ứng đầy đủ thông tin và tiêu chí tuyển dụng phù hợp, MB Bank sẽ chủ động liên hệ phỏng vấn trong thời gian sớm nhất.Ứng viên vui lòng kiểm tra email và điện thoại thường xuyên để không bỏ lỡ lịch hẹn phỏng vấn.Cập nhật ngay thông tin mới nhất về các Chương trình do MB tổ chức tại Trang tuyển dụng MB CareersVà các Fanpage:MB CareersAi Yêu Miền Bắc hơn MBers?Ai Yêu Miền Trung hơn MBers?Ai Yêu Miền Nam hơn MBers?

title: Senior Backend Developer (Django & Drf) - Remote | Vietnam-Based | Flexible Hours | Full-Time
company: CÔNG TY TNHH TƯ VẤN VÀ PHÁT TRIỂN PHẦN MỀM DEVILINK
location_raw: Hà Nội, Hồ Chí Minh, Đà Nẵng
jd_text:
Remote | Vietnam-based | Flexible Hours | Full-time DeViLink is growing! We are currently looking for a Senior Backend Developer to join our dynamic team and contribute to an exciting long-term project for a fast-growing European SaaS product company. What We Offer • Full-time, long-term opportunity working on a high-impact project for a fast-growing European SaaS product company • 100% remote - work from anywhere in Vietnam • Full Vietnamese labor benefits, including Public holidays, Social, health & unemployment insurance, 12 days of paid time off (PTO) annually • Tailored training & professional development opportunities • Modern hardware provided for an efficient work experience Your Role & Responsibilities • Own the delivery and architecture of the pricing system powering all of the client's products (iOS, Android, Web, API) and millions of users • Own your work from A to Z — from architecture and feature development through to monitoring release performance (Datadog) • Deliver product growth and pricing initiatives, iterating quickly on user feedback (the backend ships multiple times a week) • Design endpoints in direct collaboration with frontend engineers, delivering OpenAPI specifications and supporting developer documentation • Optimise existing endpoints, driving down latency and ensuring the platform continues to scale to ever greater usage • Work as part of a cross-functional, multicultural team in an agile environment

Required Qualifications • 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development with Django and Django REST Framework • Experience working with relational databases at scale — designing schemas, optimising Django queries, and running migrations with minimal downtime • Hands-on experience with a PostgreSQL or MySQL database larger than 100 GB • Experience scaling SaaS products and subscription management (e.g. Stripe, RevenueCat) • Familiarity with API design, performance optimisation, and monitoring tools such as Datadog • A pragmatic mindset: you favour speed of iteration over perfection and leverage existing frameworks and libraries rather than reinventing the wheel • Excellent English communication skills • A strong sense of ownership — you take initiative and are comfortable making product and technical decisions If you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still apply — we'd love to chat.

title: Business Analyst (Banking/ Finance)
company: SHINHAN DS
jd_text:
We are seeking an experienced Finance/ Loan Business Analyst to join our team and support the analysis, design, and implementation of business solutions, with a particular focus on systems built on or integrated with the Finance platform . The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, documented, and delivered effectively. Receive requests for product, process, and feature development or improvement from business units. Analyze requirements and advise the most effective solutions for implementation. Collaborate with developers to design solutions for business requirements. Prepare detailed requirement specifications in a format suitable for developers, ensuring clarity and technical feasibility. Coordinate with business users and QA/Test teams to validate development outcomes, ensuring solutions meet agreed business requirements. Support business units in drafting and issuing user guides and operational manuals for technology products. Deliver product and feature training sessions for IT support teams and business users when required. Conduct system testing and user acceptance testing (UAT) before deployment. Train and guide end-users on system functionalities .

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience working as a Business Analyst in finance / banking Hands-on knowledge or working experience with the Nucleus solution (or similar core banking (loan)/finance platforms) is required. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills Excellent documentation skills, with the ability to clearly define business processes and system requirements. Experience with SQL or data analysis tools is a plus. Proficient in English

jd_text:

title: Chuyên Viên Lập Trình Frontend (Angular / React Frontend Developer)
company: Chi Nhánh Trung Tâm Công Nghệ Thông Tin Tập Đoàn Bảo Việt
jd_text:
Phát triển giao diện: - Phân tích tài liệu đặc tả (SRS), tài liệu thiết kế và bản mockup/prototype để nắm bắt yêu cầu nghiệp vụ và trải nghiệm người dùng - Phát triển giao diện ứng dụng web bằng Angular hoặc React với TypeScript, đảm bảo hiệu năng và khả năng mở rộng - Xây dựng giao diện responsive, tương thích đa trình duyệt và đa thiết bị - Phát triển, chỉnh sửa và tối ưu các component/module frontend theo yêu cầu dự án Tích hợp & xử lý dữ liệu : - Tích hợp RESTful API từ backend, xử lý dữ liệu hiển thị và luồng tương tác người dùng - Quản lý state ứng dụng hiệu quả (NgRx, Redux hoặc tương đương) - Xử lý validation dữ liệu phía client và đảm bảo bảo mật cơ bản (XSS, CSRF...) Đảm bảo chất lượng: - Viết Unit Test cho các component, đảm bảo code coverage theo tiêu chuẩn dự án - Hỗ trợ đội QA và nghiệp vụ trong quá trình kiểm thử tích hợp (SIT) và kiểm thử nghiệm thu (UAT) - Tối ưu hiệu năng frontend: lazy loading, code splitting, giảm thời gian tải trang Phối hợp & tài liệu: - Phối hợp chặt chẽ với BA, Backend Developer, UI/UX Designer, QA trong suốt vòng đời dự án - Tham gia đóng góp vào tài liệu thiết kế chi tiết phần giao diện - Hỗ trợ kỹ thuật cho người dùng cuối và xử lý các vấn đề phát sinh liên quan đến giao diện Nghiên cứu & phát triển: - Nghiên cứu công nghệ mới, chủ động đề xuất giải pháp cải tiến trải nghiệm người dùng và quy trình phát triển frontend

1. Yêu cầu tối thiểu 1.1. Trình độ chuyên môn - Đào tạo: Tốt nghiệp Đại học chuyên ngành Công nghệ thông tin, Khoa học máy tính, Công nghệ phần mềm, Hệ thống thông tin hoặc các ngành liên quan. - Tiếng Anh: Đọc hiểu tài liệu kỹ thuật tiếng Anh. Có khả năng giao tiếp cơ bản bằng tiếng Anh trong công việc. 1.2. Kiến thức và kỹ năng chuyên môn - Thành thạo HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript - Có kinh nghiệm thực tế với ít nhất một trong các framework: Angular hoặc React - Hiểu biết về Responsive Design, khả năng xây dựng giao diện tương thích đa thiết bị và trình duyệt - Có kinh nghiệm tích hợp RESTful API, xử lý bất đồng bộ (Promise, Observable, async/await) - Hiểu biết về quản lý state (NgRx, Redux, Context API hoặc tương đương) - Có kiến thức về UI/UX cơ bản, khả năng triển khai giao diện từ bản thiết kế (Figma, Adobe XD...) - Sử dụng thành thạo Git (GitHub/GitLab), quen với quy trình code review và branching strategy - Có kiến thức về build tools và package manager (Webpack, Vite, npm/yarn) - Có khả năng viết Unit Test cho component (Jest, Karma, Jasmine...) 1.3. Kinh nghiệm nghề nghiệp - Tối thiểu 02 năm kinh nghiệm phát triển giao diện phần mềm ở vị trí Frontend Developer - Có kinh nghiệm làm việc trong các dự án có quy mô từ trung bình trở lên 1.4. Tố chất cá nhân - Tỉ mỉ, có mắt thẩm mỹ và chú trọng đến trải nghiệm người dùng - Chủ động học hỏi công nghệ mới và sẵn sàng thích ứng với yêu cầu dự án 2. Ưu tiên - Có kinh nghiệm làm việc trong lĩnh vực tài chính, bảo hiểm hoặc ngân hàng - Có kinh nghiệm với cả Angular và React (không chỉ một trong hai) - Có kinh nghiệm xây dựng và quản lý Design System / Component Library dùng chung cho nhiều dự án - Hiểu biết về Web Performance Optimization (lazy loading, code splitting, caching...) - Có kinh nghiệm với SSR/SSG (Next.js, Nuxt.js, Angular Universal) - Có kiến thức cơ bản về Docker/Container và quy trình CI/CD - Hiểu biết về Web Accessibility (WCAG) và bảo mật frontend (XSS, CSRF...) - Có kinh nghiệm với phát triển ứng dụng mobile (React Native, Flutter) là lợi thế. *** Các chế độ được hưởng: - Thu nhập năm cạnh tranh (bao gồm lương, thưởng và phúc lợi) - Chế độ tăng lương 1-2 lần/năm - Được đảm bảo đầy đủ các chế độ theo luật lao động (BHXH, BHYT, BHTN đóng trên tổng lương của NLĐ) - Được hưởng các khoản thưởng, phúc lợi, đãi ngộ: thưởng hiệu quả làm việc, thưởng lợi nhuận, thưởng thi đua danh hiệu, thưởng cải tiến sáng tạo, đồng phục, phúc lợi các ngày lễ, thành lập Tập đoàn,… - Được mua các loại bảo hiểm và chăm sóc sức khỏe định kỳ: Bảo hiểm sức khỏe toàn diện cho người lao động, bảo hiểm sức khỏe cho người thân… - Được đóng bảo hiểm hưu trí và bảo hiểm nhân thọ cho đến khi cán bộ về hưu - Được làm việc trong Tập đoàn lớn, môi trường chuyên nghiệp với các đơn vị thành viên thuộc các lĩnh vực bảo hiểm, tài chính, đầu tư, chứng khoán - Được tham gia các chương trình đào tạo nội bộ và Quốc tế, cấp chứng chỉ chuyên ngành.

title: Project Manager (English)
company: SHINHAN DS
jd_text:
About the Role We are striving for business expansion in different fields in the upcoming time. Join us as an IT Project Manager to: Responsibilities Lead the development team to ensure that assigned duties meet the business requirements and the company's objectives. Manage changes to the project scope, project schedule, and project costs. Build and manage project schedule to ensure work is identified, assigned and completed on time. Successfully manage the relationship with the client through clear communication patterns. Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation throughout the entire Project lifecycle. Perform risk management to minimize project risks. Identify, track, manage, prevent and resolve any project issues that may occur. Measure project performance using appropriate tools and techniques. Work directly with customers from Vietnam, Korea, and other countries. Participate in the recruiting, training and development of project staff. May perform additional tasks assigned by the manager/ BOD to ensure smooth project completion. Report to: Division Manager/ Head of Department. Manage team size 05-30 members.

Qualifications At least 5 years of experience as a Software/IT Project Manager in an IT company. Bachelor’s degree. Background in Back-end development. Candidates aged 35 or below are preferred Required Skills Proven experience in project estimation, budget control, people management and risk management. Excellent understanding of Software Development lifecycle. Good communication skills: can lead group discussions (public speaking), create teamwork oriented environment, etc. Highly responsible, well-organized, communicative, pro-active, dare-to-lead attitude. Excellent English (good in technical reading & writing and ability to communicate with foreign clients clearly and concisely). Experienced in development skills and able to review and supervise development team. Preferred Skills PMP Certificate or equivalent. Experience with business in Finance, Payment, Banking. Experience with clients and customers from Korea.

title: Trưởng Phòng Công Nghệ Thông Tin - IT Manager
company: Công ty TNHH Hóa chất AGC Việt Nam / AGC Chemicals Vietnam Co., Ltd.
location_raw: Hồ Chí Minh, Bà Rịa - Vũng Tàu
jd_text:
Địa chỉ: Khu công nghiệp Cái Mép, phường Tân Phước, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh (trước đây là tỉnh Bà Rịa Vũng Tàu) Khoảng cách: xấp xỉ 80 km (xuất phát từ Cầu Sài Gòn – cao tốc Long Thành – Công ty TNHH Hóa chất AGC Việt Nam) Objective of the Position • Lead and manage the IT Department to provide reliable, secure and efficient technology services that support business objectives and manufacturing operations. • Oversee the ERP/SAP system, business applications, digital platforms and IT infrastructure to ensure stable operation, continuous improvement and effective user support. • Drive digital transformation, process automation, IT governance and cybersecurity; ensure risk management, data backup and disaster recovery, and business continuity; and deliver IT projects in alignment with the direction of the Company and the AGC Group. • Lead and manage the IT Department to provide reliable, secure and efficient technology services that support business objectives and manufacturing operations. • Oversee ERP/SAP, business applications, digital platforms and IT infrastructure to ensure stable operation, continuous improvement and effective user support. • Drive digital transformation, process automation, cybersecurity compliance, IT governance, cybersecurity, risk management, backup/DR, business continuity practices and project execution in alignment with company and Group requirements. Major Responsibilities • IT Leadership and Service Management : Lead IT service delivery and user support to ensure reliable services. • ERP/SAP and Core Business Applications Management: Oversee ERP/SAP, business applications, reporting solutions and related support to ensure effective business operations. • IT Infrastructure, Cybersecurity and Business Continuity: Manage infrastructure, cybersecurity, backup and continuity readiness • Digital Transformation and Technology Projects : Drive automation, digital initiatives, process improvement and IT projects from planning to implementation. • IT Governance, Roadmap, Budget and Vendor Management : Manage governance, roadmap, budget, procurement and vendor performance. • People Development and Team Capability: Develop IT team capability, a service mindset and internal ownership.

Education: • Bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field. • Professional certification in IT governance or project management is an advantage. Knowledge / Skills: • Strong knowledge of ERP/SAP, enterprise applications, Microsoft 365, cloud platforms, IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, IT service management and digital technologies. • Leadership, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and project, vendor and budget management skills. • Business-oriented mindset, with the ability to translate business needs into practical technology solutions. title: Lead QA Automation Engineer
company: Safetrust
jd_text:
About the role: The Lead QA Automation Engineer is responsible for the design, build, and continuous evolution of Safetrust's test automation frameworks and CI/CD test infrastructure across mobile, web, API, and device platforms. This position plays a key role in the QA organization, turning test cases into fast, reliable, and trustworthy automated checks that gate every release. This role focuses on automation architecture, CI/CD infrastructure, and cross-layer test strategy, working as a peer to the Test Design Lead (who owns test case design and documentation), and contributes to Safetrust's continued growth by making quality feedback fast and dependable on every commit. Key Responsibilities: Automation Framework Ownership Architect, build, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for web (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright), mobile (Appium, XCUITest, Espresso), and API (REST Assured, Postman/Newman, pytest). Define coding standards, design patterns, and reusable abstractions (page objects, fixtures, test data factories, custom matchers). Own the technical health of the automation codebase: flakiness budget, runtime budget, code coverage of the framework itself, and dependency hygiene. Evaluate and roll out new tools, languages, and practices to keep our automation modern, maintainable, and fast. CI / CD Test Infrastructure Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions...) so every commit, PR, and release gets the right feedback at the right time. Design test execution strategy: smoke, regression, nightly, pre-release, post-deploy — including parallelization, sharding, and selective re-runs. Own the test infrastructure: device farms (BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, AWS Device Farm), self-hosted device labs, ephemeral test environments, and test data provisioning. Define and operate the test reporting pipeline: dashboards, failure triage flow, flaky-test quarantine, and root-cause analysis. Cross-Layer Test Strategy Drive the test pyramid in practice: push appropriate coverage down to unit and contract tests, keep end-to-end suites lean and high-signal. Partner with developers to shift quality left — testability of new features, dependency injection for tests, contract tests between services. Drive performance, load, and basic security automation where applicable (JMeter, k6, Gatling, ZAP). Ensure automation results feed back into the same test management system as manual results — one coherent picture of quality, owned jointly with the Test Design Lead. Technical Leadership Lead and mentor automation engineers across the QA team; review code and test design. Define automation KPIs (coverage, mean time to detect, mean time to triage, flake rate, suite runtime) and report them to engineering leadership. Partner with the Test Design Lead on which test cases to automate, automation priorities per release, and shared reporting standards. Plan hiring, growth, and individual development for automation engineers on the team. Define enterprise-wide automation standards, coding guidelines, and framework governance across QA Engineering. Collaborate with DevOps and Platform Engineering to continuously improve CI/CD performance, deployment quality, and automated release validation. Establish automation quality metrics and executive dashboards to measure release health, regression coverage, automation effectiveness, and defect leakage. Drive technical roadmaps for automation tooling, framework modernization, AI-assisted testing, and continuous quality engineering. Participate in architecture reviews to ensure new systems are designed for testability, observability, and automation from inception. Lead proof-of-concepts and evaluations for emerging automation technologies, AI-assisted testing tools, and cloud-based testing platforms. Champion engineering best practices including code reviews, design reviews, pair programming, documentation standards, and technical knowledge sharing across QA Engineering.

Skills & Experience: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 7+ years of experience in software QA with 2+ years leading test automation efforts. Deep, hands-on expertise designing and operating automation frameworks across at least two of: web (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright), mobile (Appium, XCUITest, Espresso), API (REST Assured, Postman/Newman, pytest). Strong programming skills in at least one of: Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript — able to write production-quality framework code, not just test scripts. Hands-on experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) including parallelization, sharding, and artifact handling. Solid understanding of testing strategy: test pyramid, risk-based testing, flakiness control, and effective use of mocks/stubs. Experience with version control workflows (Git), code review, and engineering practices applied to test code (clean code, refactoring, design patterns). Excellent communication skills and a track record of partnering with developers, QA engineers, and DevOps to deliver reliable automation at scale. Nice to Have / Preferred Experience testing IoT, embedded, or access-control products end-to-end. Experience with performance testing (JMeter, k6, Gatling) or security testing fundamentals (OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite). Familiarity with cloud-based device farms (BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, AWS Device Farm) and self-hosted device labs. Experience with containerization (Docker) and ephemeral test environments (Kubernetes, Testcontainers). Familiarity with BLE/NFC behaviour on mobile, or experience automating tests for wallet/credential apps and physical readers. ISTQB Advanced Level (Test Automation Engineer) or equivalent certification. Success Profile: The ideal candidate is: A strong software engineer at heart, applying production-grade engineering practices to test code. Pragmatic about the test pyramid and where automation adds the most value. A capable technical leader who mentors automation engineers and reviews their code. Comfortable owning CI/CD test infrastructure end-to-end. Comfortable working across regions and functions in a global environment (Vietnam, US, Australia).

title: Automotive AUTOSAR Base SW Developer (Joining bonus)
company: Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited
jd_text:
🎁 Quarter 4 JOINING BONUS Candidates with 4+ years of relevant experience who join BGSV by the end of 31 December 2026 can receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month’s gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions. MS/ESC XC Horizontal ENE Horizontal NE is a cross‑domain engineering organization within XC, responsible for developing and scaling reusable software and platform assets across ADAS, Radar, Video, and integrated vehicle computing platforms. The organization owns horizontal topics such as base software, middleware, safety, security, compute, and engineering methods, supporting XC‑CP, XC‑CE, XC‑AC, and XC‑AS products. Horizontal NE works closely with product teams to enable standardization, reuse, and technical alignment across projects. It plays a key role in building future‑ready platforms for software‑defined vehicles, ensuring high quality, efficiency, and scalability across XC portfolios. Main Roles and Responsibilities Work as part of Bosch’s global ADAS teams to develop and integrate AUTOSAR Classic BSW and diagnostics software for next‑generation driver assistance ECUs (radar, camera, sensor fusion, domain controllers). Roles & Responsibilities Develop and maintain embedded AUTOSAR Classic software (BSW and low‑level SW) for ADAS ECUs using C/C++. Configure, integrate, and debug AUTOSAR BSW modules, with focus on: Diagnostics, CAN Communication, Failure management and PDM. Collaborate closely with global system, hardware, and application teams to ensure end‑to‑end integration of BSW with ADAS applications (e.g., radar, camera, sensor fusion). Participate in the complete software development lifecycle: requirements analysis, architecture & design, implementation, unit/integration testing, debug, and maintenance. Optimize software performance and memory usage for resource-constrained embedded systems. Conduct code reviews, ensure adherence to Bosch coding guidelines, MISRA rules (if applicable), and best practices. Develop and execute unit tests and integration tests; support SIL/HIL testing and vehicle testing as needed. Ensure compliance with ISO 26262 (functional safety) and Automotive SPICE processes contribute to work products and assessments. Create and maintain software architecture, design, and interface documentation for global stakeholders. Use tools such as CANoe, CANalyzer, debuggers, emulators, and simulators for development, analysis, and issue resolution. Stay updated with the latest AUTOSAR specifications and implement compliant software solutions. Contribute to the development of software architecture and design documents. Collaborate with hardware engineers to ensure optimal software-hardware integration. Participate in technical discussions in an international, distributed team; and actively provide innovative solutions to complex engineering challenges. Work, design reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Mandatory Qualifications Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or related field. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; comfortable collaborating in global teams. Technical Skills 1-5 years of experience in embedded software development Strong Technical skills preferably in automotive domain & Good experience in programming in C, C++ for embedded systems. Experience with AUTOSAR Classic architecture and BSW and ASPICE know-how. Good understanding of microcontrollers, low‑level drivers, and embedded RTOS concepts. Experience / Familiarity in: Vehicle diagnostics and fault management SW AUTOSAR modules: Diagnostic Error Management (DEM), Diagnostic Communication Management (DCM), Communication Stack (CAN\Ethernet\LIN protocol) Automotive protocols and standards: ISO 14229, ISO 15765, ISO 14230, ISO 26262. Vehicle diagnostics and fault management SW AUTOSAR modules: Diagnostic Error Management (DEM), Diagnostic Communication Management (DCM), Communication Stack (CAN\Ethernet\LIN protocol) Automotive protocols and standards: ISO 14229, ISO 15765, ISO 14230, ISO 26262. Familiarity with CANoe, CANalyzer, and issue/requirement tracking tools (e.g., Jira, DOORS/ or similar). Prior Experience with ADAS‑related ECUs (radar, camera, sensor fusion, braking/steering controllers) is a strong plus. Soft Skills Self‑driven, proactive, and able to take ownership of modules/features end‑to‑end. Strong teamwork, interpersonal skills, and problem‑solving ability. High degree of self-discipline, quality focus, and willingness to learn new technologies in ADAS and autonomous driving.

jd_text:

Quản lý dự án danh mục (Project Management) - Tham gia triển khai các dự án phân bổ danh mục mới. - Phối hợp với Trưởng bộ phận và các phòng ban liên quan trong quá trình triển khai. - Theo dõi tiến độ, phân tích dữ liệu và đánh giá hiệu quả sau khi triển khai danh mục. 3. Phối hợp với đối tác - Là đầu mối làm việc với các đối tác về: • Phân bổ hồ sơ. • Quản lý hồ sơ (Case Management). • Đối soát và cập nhật thanh toán. - Hỗ trợ xử lý các vấn đề phát sinh liên quan đến dữ liệu và vận hành. 4. Quản lý chính sách thưởng (Incentive) - Thực hiện tính toán Incentive hàng tháng - Xây dựng, cập nhật và điều chỉnh Incentive Scheme theo yêu cầu. - Tổng hợp và gửi báo cáo Incentive cho HR, Ban lãnh đạo và các cấp quản lý đúng thời hạn. 5. Hỗ trợ vận hành - Xử lý các trường hợp hoàn trả khoản thanh toán dư. - Biên soạn, cập nhật và cải tiến các quy trình nghiệp vụ (SOP). - Soạn thảo tờ trình liên quan đến quy định, chính sách và các trường hợp phát sinh. - Tham gia các cuộc họp và hỗ trợ phân tích dữ liệu phục vụ công tác vận hành. 6. Quản lý hệ thống và cải tiến - Thực hiện kiểm thử (UAT) đối với các yêu cầu phát triển, chỉnh sửa và nâng cấp hệ thống Collection. - Kiểm tra tính chính xác của dữ liệu và chức năng hệ thống trước khi đưa vào vận hành. - Ghi nhận lỗi, phối hợp với đội phát triển để xử lý và nghiệm thu. - Đề xuất cải tiến quy trình và hệ thống nhằm nâng cao hiệu quả quản lý danh mục và thu hồi nợ. 1. Portfolio Allocation - Develop and implement monthly portfolio allocation plans in accordance with company policies. - Be responsible for developing and enhancing the portfolio allocation program. - Update allocation rules and criteria to align with business requirements and operational needs. 2. Project Management - Participate in the implementation of new portfolio allocation projects. - Collaborate with the Department Head and relevant departments throughout project implementation. - Monitor project progress, analyze data, and evaluate portfolio performance after implementation. 3. Partner Coordination - Serve as the primary point of contact with external partners regarding: • Portfolio allocation. • Case management. • Payment reconciliation and updates. - Support the resolution of operational and data-related issues. 4. Incentive Management - Calculate monthly incentive payouts. - Develop, update, and revise incentive schemes as required. - Prepare and submit incentive reports to HR, Management, and relevant stakeholders on time. 5. Operational Support - Process overpayment refund cases. - Develop, update, and improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). - Prepare proposals related to company policies, regulations, and exceptional cases. - Participate in meetings and provide data analysis to support operational activities. 6. System Management & Process Improvement - Perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for system enhancements, modifications, and upgrades to the Collection System. - Validate data accuracy and system functionality before deployment. - Report system issues, coordinate with the development team to resolve defects, and support user acceptance. - Recommend process and system improvements to enhance portfolio management and debt collection efficiency.

Trình độ - Tốt nghiệp Đại học chuyên ngành Hệ thống thông tin, Công nghệ thông tin, Khoa học dữ liệu, Tài chính, Kế toán, Ngân hàng hoặc các ngành liên quan. Kinh nghiệm - Tối thiểu 01–03 năm kinh nghiệm ở vị trí Data Analyst, MIS…. - Có kinh nghiệm làm việc trong lĩnh vực Tài chính, Ngân hàng hoặc Thu hồi nợ là một lợi thế. Kiến thức và kỹ năng - Thành thạo Microsoft Excel (Pivot, Power Query, Power Pivot, VBA là lợi thế). - Thành thạo SQL để khai thác và xử lý dữ liệu. - Biết sử dụng Power BI hoặc các công cụ trực quan hóa dữ liệu. - Có khả năng phân tích dữ liệu, xây dựng báo cáo và đánh giá hiệu quả hoạt động. - Có kỹ năng giao tiếp, phối hợp và làm việc với nhiều phòng ban và đối tác. - Có khả năng lập kế hoạch, quản lý thời gian và xử lý nhiều công việc cùng lúc. - Tư duy logic, cẩn thận, chủ động và có tinh thần cải tiến quy trình. Education - Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Information Technology, Data Science, Finance, Accounting, Banking, or a related field. Experience - At least 1–3 years of experience as a Data Analyst, MIS Analyst, or in a similar role. - Experience in Finance, Banking, or Debt Collection is an advantage. Knowledge & Skills - Proficient in Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, Power Pivot; VBA is a plus). - Strong SQL skills for data extraction and analysis. - Experience using Power BI or other data visualization tools. - Strong analytical and reporting skills with the ability to evaluate business performance. - Good communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. - Strong planning, time management, and multitasking abilities. - Logical thinking, attention to detail, a proactive mindset, and a continuous improvement attitude.

title: Java Developer (Spring Boot, Microservices, Oracle)
company: Goline Corporation
jd_text:
Thiết kế, phát triển và tối ưu các backend services sử dụng Java/Spring Boot cho các hệ thống yêu cầu cao về hiệu năng, độ ổn định và khả năng mở rộng. Tham gia phân tích yêu cầu, thiết kế giải pháp kỹ thuật và kiến trúc hệ thống; xây dựng API, microservices và các luồng xử lý nghiệp vụ phức tạp. Phát triển và tích hợp các thành phần sử dụng Oracle/PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis và các nền tảng liên quan. Phối hợp với Business, QA, DevOps và các thành viên trong team trong toàn bộ vòng đời phát triển phần mềm: thiết kế, triển khai, kiểm thử, vận hành và tối ưu hệ thống. Áp dụng AI Coding Agents và Agentic Development Workflow vào quá trình phát triển phần mềm nhằm nâng cao hiệu quả trong phân tích codebase, implementation, testing, code review, refactoring và troubleshooting. Tham gia code review, technical design review, cải thiện coding standards, kiến trúc và chất lượng kỹ thuật của hệ thống

Bắt buộc: Có từ 4 năm kinh nghiệm phát triển phần mềm. Có kinh nghiệm thiết kế và phát triển các hệ thống Microservices / Distributed Systems; hiểu các nguyên tắc và bài toán liên quan đến High Availability, Scalability, Fault Tolerance và vận hành hệ thống trong môi trường production. Có kinh nghiệm chuyên sâu trong phát triển backend với Java/Spring Boot, từ thiết kế API, xử lý business logic đến tối ưu hiệu năng, độ ổn định và khả năng bảo trì của hệ thống Có khả năng phân tích yêu cầu nghiệp vụ, thiết kế giải pháp kỹ thuật và xử lý các bài toán hệ thống phức tạp; có khả năng chủ động tham gia technical design và đưa ra các quyết định kỹ thuật phù hợp. Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với Oracle, PostgreSQL hoặc các hệ quản trị cơ sở dữ liệu quan hệ tương đương; hiểu về transaction, indexing, concurrency và tối ưu truy vấn. Có kinh nghiệm áp dụng Agentic Development Workflow trong phát triển phần mềm, sử dụng các AI Coding Agents như Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot hoặc tương đương cho các hoạt động phân tích codebase, implementation, testing, code review, refactoring và troubleshooting; có khả năng phân rã task, quản lý context, kiểm soát phạm vi thay đổi, review và validate kết quả do Agent tạo ra. Có kinh nghiệm với Kubernetes (K8s), Kafka, Redis và observability/monitoring trong các hệ thống backend thực tế. Có tinh thần ownership, chủ động xác định và giải quyết vấn đề; chịu trách nhiệm với chất lượng, độ ổn định và khả năng vận hành của hệ thống Ưu tiên: Có kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực tài chính, chứng khoán, ngân hàng hoặc Fintech. Có kinh nghiệm xây dựng, chuẩn hóa hoặc cải tiến Agentic Development Workflow ở phạm vi team hoặc project. Có kinh nghiệm xây dựng hoặc tích hợp các giải pháp LLM / AI Agent vào sản phẩm hoặc hệ thống doanh nghiệp. Có kinh nghiệm về performance tuning, production troubleshooting và system optimization. Có kinh nghiệm architecture review, mentoring hoặc technical leadership

title: Digital and Web Graphic Designer Specialist
company: Meishang Cosmetics Vietnam (Colorkey BRAND)
jd_text:

title: SAP Master Data
company: Công Ty CP Xuất Nhập Khẩu Bến Tre
jd_text:

title: Power BI  (Business Intelligence, SQL, Python, BA)
company: IONAH
jd_text:
Xây dựng và vận hành hệ thống Business Intelligence (BI) phục vụ ra quyết định cho các khối Kinh doanh, Tài chính, Dịch vụ khách hàng… hướng tới mô hình tổ chức vận hành dựa trên dữ liệu (data-driven) Mô tả công việc Phát triển và duy trì hệ thống Dashboard, KPI Report trên Power BI cho các phòng ban Thiết kế Data Model, DAX, Power Query, visual nâng cao theo chuẩn UI/UX. Tích hợp dữ liệu từ SQL, SAP, SharePoint, Excel, API; thiết lập ETL/ELT pipeline tự động. Đảm bảo chất lượng và tính toàn vẹn dữ liệu (data governance). Làm việc với các bộ phận để thu thập yêu cầu, xác định KPI, phân tích và đề xuất cải tiến dựa trên dữ liệu. Hỗ trợ và đào tạo người dùng sử dụng báo cáo Phân tích dữ liệu để tìm ra xu hướng, vấn đề, cơ hội và đưa ra các khuyến nghị dựa trên dữ liệu

Tốt nghiệp các ngành CNTT, Hệ thống thông tin, Toán – Tin, Kinh tế – Thống kê Tối thiểu 3 năm kinh nghiệm trong BI / Data Analytics / Power Platform. Thành thạo Power BI (Desktop & Service), DAX, Power Query, SQL. Có kinh nghiệm kết nối, xử lý dữ liệu đa nguồn. Ưu tiên có kinh nghiệm Power Automate, Python hoặc API integration. Tư duy hệ thống, chủ động, giao tiếp và phối hợp tốt

title: Chuyên Viên Cao Cấp Phân Tích Dữ Liệu
company: Công Ty Cổ Phần Chứng Khoán SSI
jd_text:
1. Phân tích dữ liệu và hỗ trợ ra quyết định - Thu thập, xử lý và phân tích dữ liệu từ nhiều nguồn khác nhau. - Theo dõi và đánh giá hiệu quả hoạt động thông qua các chỉ số kinh doanh (KPI). - Phân tích hành vi khách hàng, xu hướng sử dụng sản phẩm và đề xuất cơ hội tăng trưởng. - Thực hiện các phân tích chuyên sâu theo yêu cầu của các đơn vị kinh doanh. 2. Phân tích sản phẩm số (Product Analytics) - Phân tích hành vi người dùng trên ứng dụng và website giao dịch. - Xây dựng và theo dõi các chỉ số sản phẩm số như DAU, WAU, MAU, Conversion Rate, Retention Rate và Churn Rate. - Phân tích Funnel nhằm xác định các điểm rơi (Drop-off) trong hành trình khách hàng. - Đánh giá hiệu quả các tính năng mới và đề xuất cải thiện trải nghiệm người dùng. 3. Báo cáo và trực quan hóa dữ liệu - Xây dựng và duy trì Dashboard phục vụ quản trị và vận hành. - Thiết kế báo cáo định kỳ và Self-service Reporting. - Đảm bảo các chỉ số và định nghĩa dữ liệu được sử dụng thống nhất trong toàn tổ chức. 4. Khai thác và mô hình hóa dữ liệu phục vụ phân tích - Viết truy vấn SQL để khai thác, tổng hợp và phân tích dữ liệu. - Tham gia thiết kế mô hình dữ liệu (Data Modeling) phục vụ phân tích. - Làm việc với Data Warehouse, Data Lake và các nguồn dữ liệu nghiệp vụ. - Phối hợp với Data Engineer để cải thiện chất lượng dữ liệu và khả năng khai thác dữ liệu. 5. Quản lý chất lượng dữ liệu và Tracking - Thiết lập, kiểm tra và quản lý Event Tracking trên App/Web. - Phối hợp xây dựng tài liệu Tracking Specification. - Kiểm tra tính đầy đủ, chính xác và nhất quán của dữ liệu. - Phát hiện và phối hợp xử lý các vấn đề liên quan đến dữ liệu.

1. Kiến thức và kinh nghiệm - Tốt nghiệp Đại học chính quy chuyên ngành Kinh tế, Tài chính, Công nghệ thông tin, Khoa học Dữ liệu hoặc các ngành liên quan. - Tối thiểu 3 năm kinh nghiệm tương tự với vị trí Chuyên viên - Ưu tiên ứng viên có kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực tài chính, chứng khoán, ngân hàng hoặc fintech. 2. Kỹ năng chuyên môn - Thành thạo SQL, sử dụng Power BI, Superset, Tableau hoặc Looker Studio. - Hiểu Data Warehouse, Data Modeling, ETL/ELT. - Hiểu Funnel Analysis, Cohort Analysis, Retention và Conversion. - Có kinh nghiệm với GA4, Firebase hoặc Adjust là lợi thế. 3. Kỹ năng mềm - Tư duy phân tích và giải quyết vấn đề tốt. - Khả năng diễn giải dữ liệu thành insight kinh doanh. - Chủ động, cẩn thận và có tinh thần học hỏi.

title: Business Analyst – POEMS Digital Trading (Agile, Jira)
company: CyberQuote Pte Ltd
jd_text:
About the Role We are looking for a highly driven Business Analyst to help shape and deliver enhancements across the POEMS Digital Trading platform. This role goes beyond requirements gathering and documentation. You will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, operations teams, and technology teams to identify opportunities, solve business problems, drive decisions, and ensure successful delivery of digital trading initiatives. You will play a critical role in bridging business and technology, translating complex requirements into actionable solutions, and ensuring initiatives are delivered with quality, speed, and business value. Success in this role requires strong analytical thinking, excellent communication skills, comfort working with ambiguity, and a proactive approach to driving outcomes. Key Responsibilities Business Analysis & Solution Design (70%) Gather, analyze, and document business requirements, translating them into clear functional and non-functional specifications. Conduct process reviews, gap analyses, and impact assessments to support new initiatives and system enhancements. Translate business requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, and process models. Collaborate with business and technology teams to design, validate, and implement effective solutions. Challenge assumptions constructively and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and customer experience. Analyze business and production issues, perform root cause analysis, and recommend practical and sustainable solutions. Evaluate risks, dependencies, constraints, and alternative approaches to support informed decision-making and successful delivery outcomes. Project Delivery & Agile Coordination (20%) Maintain requirements documentation, traceability, and project artefacts throughout the project lifecycle. Track requirements, issues, risks, action items, decisions, and project progress using Jira or similar project tracking tools. Support Agile delivery activities, including backlog management, sprint planning, sprint ceremonies, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and release coordination. Communication & Stakeholder Management (10%) Facilitate stakeholder alignment, provide clear project status updates, and proactively manage risks, blockers, dependencies, and escalations.

Strong verbal and written communication skills in both English and Vietnamese. Bachelor's Degree in Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline. 2 to 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or related role, preferably within financial services, capital markets, brokerage, or online trading platforms. Strong understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies. Strong stakeholder management, requirements analysis, and facilitation skills. Hands-on experience using Jira, AI productivity tools, or similar project and collaboration platforms. Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to structure and clarify ambiguous or incomplete information. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to follow through on commitments. Confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and influence outcomes through logical reasoning and data-driven analysis. Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. Familiarity with the securities trading lifecycle, including pre-trade, middle-office, and post-trade processes, would be a strong advantage.

title: IT Operations Manager (Networking/ Cybersecurity/ Compliance)
company: MiTek Việt Nam
jd_text:
About the job The IT Operation Manager is responsible for overseeing IT services to support MiTek Vietnam Services. The role has a key leadership role in owning E2E all infrastructure and networking including Planning, Delivery and Operations and Endpoint support. This role will lead a team of IT professionals, manage budget and resources, and implement IT policies and best practices and collaborate closely with IT Director Vietnam Services to deliver on the scope of this role. jd_text:

jd_text:
1. Network System Management and Operations: Monitor, configure, operate, and troubleshoot LAN/WAN network systems, firewalls, routers, switches, and VPNs. title: Chief Information Officer
company: CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN TẬP ĐOÀN Y KHOA SÀI GÒN
level_raw: Giám Đốc và Cấp Cao Hơn
jd_text:
The Chief Information Officer (CIO) is a Group-level executive responsible for shaping and leading the Group’s technology strategy, digital agenda, and enterprise-wide technology-enabled transformation. The CIO partners with the senior leadership, and business leaders to translate the Group’s strategic priorities into technology and transformation initiatives that create measurable business value, strengthen patient and employee experience, improve operational performance, and enable sustainable growth. The CIO is accountable for the Group’s overall technology ecosystem, including enterprise architecture, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data, business applications, digital platforms, technology governance, and technology investment. The role leads the evolution from a primarily IT-operating function toward a scalable, integrated, data-driven and digitally enabled enterprise. The CIO also leads technology integration and transformation in a complex, multi-site healthcare environment, including standardization and integration across entities and support for M&A activities. The role is expected to balance reliability and risk management with innovation, speed, and business transformation. The Chief Information Officer reports directly to the Group Chief Executive Officer RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Group Technology Strategy & Governance - Define and lead the Group’s multi-year technology strategy and roadmap in alignment with the Group’s business strategy, growth plans, patient-centric strategy, and future operating model. - Translate business priorities into clear technology priorities, investment themes, transformation programs, and measurable outcomes. - Establish the Group’s technology governance framework, decision rights, standards, architecture principles, policies, and technology operating model. - Advise the Executive Leadership Team on technology opportunities, risks, emerging technologies, major investments, and implications for business strategy. - Continuously assess the maturity of the Group’s technology landscape and define the target-state architecture and capabilities required to support future growth. 2. Enterprise Technology & Business Transformation - Lead the Group’s enterprise-wide Technology & Business Transformation agenda, moving beyond technology implementation to redesign processes, ways of working, capabilities, and operating models. - Develop and govern a transformation portfolio with clear priorities, business cases, milestones, ownership, investment requirements, and measurable benefits. - Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, digitalization, data-driven decision-making, and service innovation. - Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable improvements in patient experience, employee experience, productivity, operational efficiency, quality, scalability, and business performance. - Lead organizational change and adoption, ensuring that new technologies, processes, and ways of working are embedded effectively across the Group. - Build a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and technology-enabled problem solving across the organization. 3. Digital, Data, Analytics & Emerging Technology - Define the Group’s digital and data strategy as an integral component of the overall business and technology strategy. - Establish the capabilities required to leverage data and analytics for management decision-making, operational performance, financial visibility, patient experience, and business growth. - Evaluate and prioritize the practical application of AI, automation, cloud, advanced analytics, and other emerging technologies based on business value, scalability, risk, and readiness. - Promote a data-driven culture and strengthen data governance, data quality, data ownership, accessibility, and responsible use of data across the Group. 4. Enterprise Architecture, Applications & Integration - Own the enterprise technology architecture and application landscape, ensuring scalability, interoperability, security, reliability, and alignment with the Group’s target operating model. - Lead the Group’s business applications roadmap and future capabilities, including the rollout and optimization of core systems across the network. - Drive integration and standardization across hospitals, clinics, Head Office, and other entities to reduce fragmentation and improve enterprise visibility. - Ensure technology solutions and architecture are designed to support future business expansion, new entities, and M&A integration. - Drive continuous improvement in application performance, usability, stability, releases, upgrades, and lifecycle management. 5. Technology Infrastructure, Operations & Service Excellence - Ensure a resilient, scalable, secure, and high-performing technology infrastructure that supports critical healthcare and corporate operations. - Oversee IT service management and establish service levels that meet the needs of clinical, operational, and corporate stakeholders. - Manage strategic technology vendors and partners, ensuring commercial value, service quality, performance, and accountability. - Establish appropriate sourcing and delivery models across internal teams, managed services, professional services, and strategic technology partners. 6. Cybersecurity, Data Protection & Technology Risk - Own the Group’s overall cybersecurity, information security, data protection, and technology risk agenda. - Establish and continuously strengthen security standards, controls, policies, monitoring, incident response, and risk mitigation practices. - Ensure compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, and industry requirements relating to information security and data protection. - Lead technology risk assessment and mitigation for major transformation initiatives, new technologies, third-party arrangements, and M&A activities. - Ensure robust disaster recovery, business continuity, backup, and resilience capabilities for critical systems and data. 7. Technology Investment, Financial Management & Value Realization - Own the Group technology budget and investment portfolio, ensuring resources are allocated to the highest-value strategic priorities. - Develop robust business cases for major technology and transformation investments, including cost, benefit, risk, implementation roadmap, and expected return. - Track technology investment performance and benefits realization, linking technology spend to measurable business outcomes and value creation. - Drive cost optimization and technology rationalization without compromising service quality, security, resilience, or strategic capability. 8. M&A, Enterprise Integration & Scalability - Provide technology leadership for M&A and expansion activities, including technology due diligence, integration planning, transition, standardization, and post-merger stabilization. - Identify technology constraints and opportunities that may affect organic or acquisitive growth and adapt the technology strategy accordingly. - Define scalable integration standards and architecture principles to enable efficient onboarding of new hospitals, clinics, and other entities. 9. Executive Partnership & Business Leadership - Act as a strategic business partner to the Executive Leadership Team, translating technology topics into business implications, options, risks, and decisions. - Build strong relationships with clinical, operational, commercial, finance, HR, and corporate functions to ensure technology priorities are business-led rather than technology-led. - Provide clear executive-level reporting on technology performance, transformation progress, key risks, investment status, and business outcomes. - Represent the Group in strategic relationships with technology partners, industry organizations, and relevant external stakeholders. 10. Organization, Talent & Leadership - Build and lead a high-performing Group technology organization with the capabilities required for the future state of MSG. - Develop the organization structure, leadership pipeline, capabilities, and talent strategy across technology, digital, data, architecture, cybersecurity, applications, infrastructure, and transformation. - Coach, develop, and empower technology leaders and teams while establishing clear accountability, performance standards, and collaboration across the Group. - Create an operating culture characterized by business partnership, innovation, accountability, service excellence, and continuous improvement.

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field; a Master’s degree or MBA is preferred. - 10+ years of experience in senior technology leadership roles, preferably at CIO, CTO, or IT Director level. - Significant senior leadership experience in technology, digital transformation, or technology-enabled business transformation, preferably in a complex multi-site organization. - Proven track record of leading enterprise-wide technology and business transformation and translating business strategy into a technology and transformation roadmap. - Strong business acumen and financial mindset, with demonstrated ability to evaluate technology investments based on business value, ROI, risk, and long-term strategic impact. - Experience leading large-scale transformation, organizational change, stakeholder adoption, and cross-functional programs involving multiple business units and locations. - Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, business applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data & analytics, cloud, automation, AI, and digital platforms. - Experience in healthcare, HIS/EMR, or deployment and integration of core systems across multi-location businesses such as banking, insurance, retail, or other complex regulated industries is highly preferable. - Experience in M&A technology due diligence, integration, standardization, or post-merger technology transformation is an advantage. - Excellent executive communication, influencing, negotiation, stakeholder management, and change leadership skills. - Strong people leadership capability with experience building and developing high-performing technology organizations. - High energy, strategic, pragmatic, and comfortable operating in ambiguity and complex transformation environments. - Strong alignment with MSG PCARES culture: Patient Centricity, Compliance, Accountability, Respect, Excellence, and Sympathy

title: Technical Project Leader
company: CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN JARVIS GLOBAL
jd_text:
Technical LeaderĐịnh hướng giải pháp kỹ thuật cho các dự án của công ty, review và đánh giá technical solution trước khi triển khai.Review code, architecture, database, API và các vấn đề kỹ thuật quan trọng.Chủ động phát hiện technical risk, bottleneck và đưa ra phương án xử lý.Hỗ trợ Developer trong việc giải quyết các vấn đề khó, coding convention, development process và documentation.Có khả năng sử dụng AI như một công cụ hỗ trợ phân tích, research và productivity nhưng không phụ thuộc vào AI trong việc đưa ra quyết định chuyên môn.BA / Requirement LeadershipDẫn dắt và mentor đội ngũ BA trong việc phân tích yêu cầu và quản lý scope.Review Business Requirement, User Story, Use Case, Acceptance Criteria, Business Flow và các tài liệu BA trước khi chuyển sang Development.Kiểm soát scope, phát hiện requirement creep và đánh giá impact khi khách hàng thay đổi yêu cầu.Review chất lượng đầu ra của BA và đưa ra feedback định kỳ.Project & Delivery ManagementLà người chịu trách nhiệm chính về tiến độ và chất lượng delivery của technical team.Estimate effort và xác định resource cần thiết cho từng task.Theo dõi tiến độ hàng ngày/tuần và chủ động xử lý các blocker. Phát hiện sớm nguy cơ trễ deadline và đưa ra phương án xử lý.Quản lý dependencies giữa BA – Developer – QA – khách hàng.Đảm bảo các task quan trọng được follow đến khi hoàn thành, không để công việc bị "treo"Chủ động báo cáo Management về tiến độ, risk, issue và các quyết định cần hỗ trợ.Có khả năng trực tiếp "đẩy" những task quan trọng đến completion thay vì chỉ phân công và chờ nhân viên xử lý.Team LeadershipQuản lý và phân bổ công việc cho Developer/BA theo năng lực và workload.Theo dõi performance và chất lượng công việc của team.Coaching và mentoring thành viên trong team.Review năng lực định kỳ và đề xuất kế hoạch phát triển cho từng thành viên.Xây dựng môi trường làm việc có tính ownership, collaboration và accountability.Chủ động xử lý conflict trong team.Không quản lý theo kiểu micromanagement nhưng phải nắm được tình trạng thực tế của từng project/task.Là cầu nối giữa Management và Technical Team.

Kinh nghiệmCó 4 năm kinh nghiệm trong Software Development / Software Engineering.Tối thiểu 2–3 năm ở vai trò Tech Lead / Senior Engineer có trách nhiệm dẫn dắt team hoặc dự án.Có kinh nghiệm dẫn dắt team từ 5–10 người hoặc tương đương.Ưu tiên ứng viên từng làm Technical Lead, Solution Lead, Engineering Lead hoặc Technical Project Lead.Ưu tiênCó khả năng đánh giá độc lập, kiểm chứng thông tin và đưa ra quyết định dựa trên technical knowledge và dữ liệu thực tế; sử dụng AI như công cụ hỗ trợ thay vì phụ thuộc vào AICó khả năng đưa ra quyết định khi team gặp vấn đề thay vì trì hoãn hoặc phụ thuộc hoàn toàn vào cấp trên.Có khả năng cân bằng giữa technical quality, business requirement, timeline và customer expectation.Không bảo thủ về technology/process; quyết định dựa trên context và business impact.

jd_text:
Trưởng Phòng Kỹ thuật người chịu trách nhiệm cao nhất về công nghệ cho OMICall — nền tảng tổng đài chăm sóc khách hàng đa kênh ứng dụng AI (VoIP, Call Center, tích hợp CRM, Callbot, Voice Analysis).. Trách nhiệm chính Xây dựng và thực thi chiến lược, roadmap công nghệ cho sản phẩm OMICall, phù hợp mục tiêu kinh doanh của Ban giám đốc Định hướng kiến trúc hệ thống tổng đài đa kênh: VoIP/SIP core, tích hợp đa kênh (Facebook, Zalo, Website, Hotline), CRM, Callbot, AI Voice Analysis Đảm bảo hệ thống vận hành ổn định, high availability cho khách hàng doanh nghiệp đang sử dụng dịch vụ (uptime, chất lượng cuộc gọi, độ trễ) Xây dựng, đào tạo và phát triển đội ngũ kỹ thuật của dự án OMI: tuyển dụng, career path, đánh giá năng lực, giữ chân nhân tài Dẫn dắt việc tích hợp AI vào sản phẩm (Callbot, Voice Analysis, chatbot đa kênh) và vào quy trình phát triển (AI-assisted coding) Phối hợp với đội ngũ kinh doanh/sản phẩm để đánh giá yêu cầu khách hàng doanh nghiệp, xây dựng roadmap tính năng, hỗ trợ demo/POC khi cần Quản lý ngân sách công nghệ của dự án: hạ tầng viễn thông, cloud, license, công cụ AI, đảm bảo hiệu quả chi phí Đảm bảo bảo mật dữ liệu khách hàng, tuân thủ quy định viễn thông và bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân Báo cáo định kỳ cho CTO /Ban giám đốc về tình hình công nghệ, rủi ro và đề xuất cải tiến sản phẩm OMI

title: Senior Software Project Manager Cum Agile Team Coach
company: Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited
jd_text:
About the role: This is a once-in-a-career opportunity to join Bosch Digital’s Global Product Team at a defining moment. We are leading the transformation and migration of global digital products<ins>, including the launch of a <ins>new core business workflow platform<ins> - and we’re looking for passionate, driven leaders to help shape the future.As a Senior Software Project Manager cum Agile Team Coach<ins>, you will be at the heart of this transformation, working alongside a talented, cross-functional global team. You’ll drive complex, high-impact projects from concept to delivery, using Agile methodologies and AI-powered solutions to bring innovation to life. If you’re looking for a role where your work truly matters—where you can influence global platforms, collaborate with top-tier talent, and grow in a culture of innovation—this is your moment. <ins>Your main roles & responsibilities: • Lead the Migration of a New Core Workflow Platform - Oversee the migration of 250+ applications, ensuring timelines are met and aligned with business priorities - Integrate new application requests and change requirements into the migration roadmap with precision and agility. - Apply AI-driven planning and automation to streamline delivery and enhance decision-making. • Ensure High-Quality, On-Time Delivery - Implement a robust quality management framework to ensure all deliverables meet Bosch’s global standards. - Apply technical risk management strategies to proactively identify and resolve issues. - Maintain a clear focus on timeline management, balancing migration efforts with new development needs. • Stakeholder Engagement & Team Collaboration - Facilitate and moderate cross-functional meetings across global teams, ensuring alignment and transparency. - Resolve conflicts constructively and foster a harmonious team spirit to drive on-time delivery. • Coach teams in Agile practices and continuous improvement.

• Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or related fields. • 8+ years of experience in Agile project management or product delivery roles. • Strong experience in project management - Migration Planning & Execution: Experience managing large-scale migrations with complex dependencies. - Application Lifecycle Management: Ability to handle new and changing requirements alongside migration efforts. - AI & Automation Integration: Familiarity with applying AI tools to optimize planning, tracking, and reporting. - Risk & Timeline Management: Proven ability to manage technical risks and deliver on schedule. - Tool Proficiency: Skilled in using project management tools. • Expert in Agile Team Coaching (ATC) - Facilitation & Moderation: Expert in leading cross-functional collaboration across global teams. - Team Harmony & Conflict Resolution: Skilled in maintaining team morale and resolving challenges swiftly. - Agile Mindset: Strong coaching ability to embed Agile principles and foster continuous learning. • Proficient in English • Excellent communication and leadership skills. • Certifications such as PMP, Scrum Master, or Agile Coach are a plus

title: Modern ERP Software Engineer
company: Koidra Tech
jd_text:
Koidra isn't just building software; we are building the brain for industrial automation . To support this mission, we're working on a special project: build a business hub software (called BizHub), tailored for manufacturing companies, to best capture the operational data at a factory before feeding it to the AI engine. Most factories still run on spreadsheets and a decade-old ERP nobody enjoys opening. BizHub replaces both. We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Engineer (with strong backend capabilities) to help us launch this project to success. Own the stack end-to-end: Django Ninja, Pydantic and PostgreSQL through Vue 3.5, and TanStack Query, deployed on Kubernetes with Helm. Orchestrate AI agents : architect and review the agents that write most of the code. You define what "good" means here and encode it as types, rules and tests instead of repeating it in prompts. Model the domain : production planning, supply chain management, etc. Get the model right and the screens mostly fall out of it.

Deep fullstack engineering : 7+ years shipping production software, with real depth in Python and TypeScript. You can judge the quality of code you did not write, which is most of the code here. AI-native : you have spent the last year on agentic coding and know the difference between a lazy prompt and a specification that produces code you would sign. You build verification loops, property-based tests and static analysis gates that catch agent mistakes before they merge. Data modelling is your strength : ERP is a modelling problem wearing a UI. Multi-tenant PostgreSQL, migrations against live data, money, calendars and shift boundaries that cannot be 1% wrong at month end. Paranoid about Safety: You understand that “hallucination” in a chatbot is annoying, but hallucination in an industrial control system is catastrophic. You know how to build verification loops, property-based tests, and static analysis gates that catch AI errors before they merge. Systems Thinker: You care about the “why” and the “how”. You can explain the whys and whys not of the engineering decisions, whether made by yourself or your AI agents. Nice to have : ERP or Supply Chain Management software experience

title: Application Support Officer
company: Shinhan Vietnam Finance Company Limited
jd_text:
The Application Support Officer is responsible for ensuring the stable operation, maintenance, and support of enterprise applications. The role focuses on application monitoring, incident resolution, user support, system testing, and continuous improvement to ensure business operations run smoothly. 1. Application Monitoring & Support • Monitor application performance and perform routine health checks. • Provide application support and troubleshoot issues to ensure timely resolution. • Coordinate with users, vendors, and internal teams to investigate and resolve incidents. • Support application deployment, upgrades, and maintenance activities. • Maintain application documentation, user guides, and support procedures. • Escalate complex issues and follow up until resolution. 2. Support Project • Support UAT activities, including test data preparation, data synchronization, and environment support for new projects and system enhancements. • Assist users during testing, troubleshoot issues, and track defects to ensure timely resolution. 3. Continuous Improvement • Identify opportunities to improve application performance and support processes. • Collaborate with stakeholders to implement system enhancements. • Continuously update knowledge of supported applications and business processes. 4. Shift Support • Being available to work in shifts, including weekends, public holidays, or on-call support when required. • Support critical incidents and production issues outside normal business hours to ensure system availability.

1. Qualification • University Degree majored in Information Technology 2. Work Experience • Minimum 03 years working experience in Software development and Application support. • Have working experience in Finance/Banking/Insurance is a plus. 3. Knowledge • Monitor and do health check to ensure applications are in good status • Able to communicate effectively with different stake holders • Good at business analysis and system analysis. • Consult effective solutions for BUs. • Good at trouble shooting, root cause analysis • Support BA & Technical roles in the projects of development team • Knowledge on software development even join development team to develop when necessary • At least 3 years’ experience in Software development and application support 4. Skills • Experience on application development and deployment (DevOps) • Experience on either Java, PL/SQL. • Good experience on ITIL framework and process. • Communication • Problem-solving • Effective application support • Good collaboration • Critical thinking • Can-do attitude • Time management

title: Principal AI-native Full-stack Software Engineer
company: Koidra Tech
jd_text:
Koidra isn't just building software; we are building the brain for industrial automation . We are looking for a Principal AI-Native Software Engineer to build software together with the CEO. You will orchestrate the AI agents that write the code in conjunction with your hand-crafted code. Your work will enable our team to remain lean, hyper-efficient, and focused on our core DNA: Autonomous Physical Agents . Orchestrate AI agents: You will guide and architect senior-level AI agents (via Claude Code++) that generate safe, bug-free, and high-performance code at scale. Master the Deep Stack: You will own the architecture of our end-to-end stack. Push the State of the Art: You will constantly keep Koidra’s engineering velocity 10x higher than industry standards. Force-Multiply the Team: You will enable our domain experts (physicists, agronomists, control engineers) to ship production-grade software by giving them AI-powered tools that translate their math into robust code.

AI-native Software Engineering : You have 5+ years of deep software engineering experience, but you have spent the last year obsessed with Agentic AI for coding. You know the difference between a “lazy prompt” and a “robust system spec” that produces solid code. Paranoid about Safety: You understand that “hallucination” in a chatbot is annoying, but hallucination in an industrial control system is catastrophic. You know how to build verification loops, property-based tests, and static analysis gates that catch AI errors before they merge. Polyglot Master: You are comfortable auditing code in Python, Rust, and TypeScript. You don't need to write every line, but you must be able to judge the quality of the AI’s output in any of these languages. Systems Thinker: You care about the “why” and the “how”. You can explain the whys and whys not of the engineering decisions, whether made by yourself or your AI agents, to both the CEO and other engineers.

title: Data Analyst

jd_text:

title: AI Automation Engineer (Senior/Lead)
company: PLAYSTUDIOS
jd_text:
1. Technical Leadership & Team Development: Senior level: Lead the design, development, and implementation of AI-powered automation solutions. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to team members through code reviews and knowledge sharing. Contribute to engineering standards, documentation, and best practices for automation tooling and AI-assisted workflows. Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, well-documented, and reusable across projects and titles. Lead level: Lead and mentor a team of AI Automation Engineers. Provide technical direction and code-level leadership across automation initiatives. Define and maintain engineering standards, processes, and best practices for automation and AI-assisted workflows. Drive the development of scalable, maintainable, and reusable solutions across multiple titles. Support team growth, hiring, and capability development as the studio expands. 2. Hands-on Automation Engineering Design and implement automation tools and scripts that eliminate repetitive operational work. Build reusable operational tooling that can be used across multiple game teams. Collaborate directly with Game Engineers and technical owners to automate operational tasks. Maintain and evolve internal tooling used for LiveOps operations, QA workflows, and release support. 3. AI-Assisted Engineering and Tooling Promote practical adoption of AI-assisted development tools within automation workflows. Experiment with AI-driven approaches to automation generation, log analysis, and operational diagnostics. Identify opportunities where AI can improve debugging, operational insight, and engineering productivity. Work with technical leadership to ensure responsible and effective use of AI across the studio. 4. Operational Efficiency and Workflow Improvements Identify and reduce manual work across LiveOps, QA, and operational processes through targeted automation. Design and implement scalable workflows and reusable tooling to improve consistency and engineering leverage across titles. Address root causes of operational issues and implement preventive improvements to reduce recurrence and increase reliability. 5. Monitoring and Operational Visibility Improve monitoring, logging, and diagnostics to provide clear and reliable visibility into production systems. Build tools that enable engineers to quickly understand system behavior and investigate issues in production. Strengthen observability and alerting practices to enable faster detection and more effective troubleshooting of incidents. 6. Collaboration with DevOps and Platform Teams Work with the central DevOps team when automation interacts with deployment pipelines or infrastructure systems. Collaborate with the platform teams when automation interacts with shared services, internal tools or platform capabilities. Ensure studio automation tooling aligns with existing platform and DevOps standards. Focus primarily on automation and engineering tooling , rather than infrastructure ownership.

REQUIREMENTS 4+ years of experience in software engineering, developer tooling, or automation. Good command of written and spoken English. Strong scripting or programming skills (at least one of the following: C#, Java, Python, TypeScript, or similar). Experience building automation tools, developer tooling, or operational systems. Experience using AI-assisted development tools as part of engineering workflows. (Claude Code, OpenCode, LangChain, Codex, Devin...) Strong understanding of software development workflows and engineering productivity tools. Preferred Experience Experience mentoring or leading engineers in a technical capacity. Experience working on live products or operational systems . Experience building internal developer tools or automation frameworks . Exposure to monitoring, logging, and operational diagnostics tooling. Basic understanding of CI/CD systems or cloud infrastructure. Additional Notes: Infrastructure and DevOps responsibilities are primarily handled by the central DevOps team. Experience in these areas is helpful but not required. You may be expected to complete a test as part of the interviewing procedure.

title: Data Analysis Supervisor
company: Công Ty Cổ Phần Hàng Tiêu Dùng Masan
jd_text:
Job Summary The Data Analysis Supervisor is responsible for overseeing data analysis related to legal compliance and operational efficiency, utilizing tools like Excel and Power BI to generate insights and reports. This role involves collaborating with various departments to ensure adherence to regulations, optimizing data management systems, and providing training to team members. Prefer candidates with 3-5 years of experience in data analysis, legal support, or compliance, especially in the FMCG sector. Job Responsibilities Data Analysis: - Analyze and synthesize data related to legal and compliance issues across the Company/Departments within MCH. - Use analytical tools (such as Excel, SQL, Power BI, etc.) to collect, process, and analyze data, creating detailed reports to support decision-making processes. Data System Management - Assess and optimize the current information system to ensure effective and secure data storage and processing. - Propose and implement system improvements to enhance performance and data security, connecting to the Group’s common data system. Support For Compliance Activities - Provide data and analysis to support the Company's compliance activities according to legal regulations and internal policies of MCH. - Collaborate with the Internal Control Department and the Legal Department in analyzing, assessing, and monitoring compliance risk systems, proposing measures to mitigate these risks. Development Of Reports And Input Information - Design and develop reporting dashboards for relevant departments. - Communicate information and analysis results to the Legal & Compliance Director and other departments clearly and accurately. Training And Technical Support - Guide employees in using tools and information systems for compliance and legal work. - Update standards, processes, and policies related to information technology, data security, and analysis. Utilize analytical tools to monitor changes in legal regulations and analyze their impact on the Company's operations.

Skills Business English Data Analytics MS Excel MS Power BI Functional Competencies Regulatory Compliance Dispute and Legal Risk Management Database Design & Management Project Management

title: AN1, IT Services & User Support Technician - IT Department
company: Mizuho Bank, Ltd.
jd_text:
Mizuho Bank, Hanoi Branch is seeking a customer-focused and proactive IT User Support Specialist to join our end-user support function. Reporting directly to the AVP, User Support Team Lead, this role is responsible for executing daily IT Service Desk Level 1 operations, supporting end-user devices, and ensuring timely and professional assistance for branch users in a controlled banking environment. The successful candidate will act as the first point of contact for IT issues, handle daily service requests, and maintain service quality and operational discipline. This role works closely with the User Support Team Lead and collaborates with internal IT teams to deliver reliable workplace IT support. What you will do • Act as the first point of contact for branch users, providing Level 1 IT Service Desk support. • Receive, log, and manage daily incidents and service requests via the ticketing system. • Ensure timely resolution of basic IT issues and properly escalate complex incidents to the Team Lead or specialized IT teams (Infrastructure, Security, etc.). • Set up, configure, and troubleshoot PCs, laptops, printers, peripherals, mobile devices, and standard workplace applications. • Assist with user onboarding and offboarding processes, including physical device allocation and account setup/removal coordination. • Maintain accurate ticket records, support logs, and assist in updating operational documentation. • Follow internal control requirements, IT policies, and compliance guidelines during daily operations. • Contribute to continuous improvement in user support processes and overall user satisfaction.

• Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. • 2 to 3 years of experience in IT support, helpdesk, end-user support, or endpoint support (Fresh graduates with strong internship experience in IT support may also be considered). • Hands-on knowledge of: • Windows environment • PCs, laptops, and user devices hardware • Endpoint support and basic troubleshooting • Microsoft 365 / Office applications • User account management and basic access-related support • Familiarity with Ticketing and service management tools. • Basic understanding of ITIL principles and incident management is a plus. • Strong communication, customer service, and problem-solving skills with a helpful and patient attitude. • Fluency in English, both spoken and written, is required. • Experience in banking or another regulated corporate environment is an advantage.
